name: x_repost
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC: repost (retweet) a post as the account. Returns { data: { retweeted: true } }. This puts someone else's words on the account's timeline — treat it as publishing.

id.description: The acting user's id, from x_me.

tweet_id.description: Post id, the `data.id` a post returned, e.g. '1790000000000000000'.
